entities.summary: Muslim, a notable figure in the history of Jordan, associated with Early Islamic Jordan and Umayyad Desert Castles (629–661). Preceded by Umayyad Caliphate and Battle of Mu'tah — one of the first Muslim encounters with the Byzantine Empire. Their legacy influenced Battle of Yarmouk — decisive Muslim victory ending Byzantine rule in the Levant and Umayyad Desert Castles.
